reviews.text: This was the first class I took at Berkeley as part of the Freshman Edge program. It is the best class I've taken in my entire life. Professor Strang always had well-organized lecture notes, well-prepared lectures, and highly detailed examples and explanations to build intuition. The content was also at the perfect level where it was just challenging enough to be interesting and require effort, but not challenging enough to become dull and boring. I loved every moment of being in this class.
reviews.title: One of my favorite classes of all time
